title: IncuBrix Timeline Schema
description: Defines the non-destructive timeline data model for prompt-based video editing.

id.description: Unique identifier for this timeline instance (UUID v4).

source_media_id.description: Identifier of the immutable source media asset.

segments.description: Ordered sequence of media segments representing current playback composition.

anchors.description: Semantic content anchors (captions, mutes, bleeps) attached to source-time coordinates.

background_music.description: Optional background music track configuration with speech ducking parameters.

auto_captions_enabled.description: Whether automated speech-to-text captions are generated across all segments.

source_media_id.description: Reference to the original source asset.

source_start_s.description: Half-open interval start in source media time (seconds).

source_end_s.description: Half-open interval end in source media time (seconds).

speed.description: Playback speed multiplier. Segment timeline duration equals (source_end_s - source_start_s) / speed.

duration_s.description: Computed timeline presentation duration in seconds.

source_media_id.description: Identifier of the source media this content belongs to.

source_start_s.description: Start timestamp in original source audio/video (seconds).

source_end_s.description: End timestamp in original source audio/video (seconds).

properties.description: Anchor metadata including text content, font size, color, position, or volume.

active.description: True if underlying source content is currently present in the timeline.

warning.description: Diagnostic warning if anchor content was partially cut, accelerated, or suppressed.
